body:
Confirmed regression at integration23799bb63832470014b96a4be57a7e564a335e76. GitHub CI36713890494 job109882451752 fails internal/mcp/bridge TestCEMReportToolPreviewsCLIReportWithoutPublishing attools_test.go:101. Expected byte-identical readonly preview under existing MCPV0-025; actual mismatch. Logs /private/tmp/corvint-wow-manager/merge-ci-product-0.log andmcp-preview-baseline.log. Existing source Corvintcontext READY with retained14omittedresults and affectedLANGUAGE_FRONTIER unknowns. Fix restoring original parity contract is needed for owner-requested PR385 merge.

Additional confirmed CI repair friction: run 36723447579 at e3ff3b72 passed every shard0 test, then failed test -z "$(gofmt -l cmd internal tools)" before vet and Windows compilation. Exact gofmt -d showed only map-field whitespace at internal/cem/workflow/read.go:130 introduced by this preview repair. Expected canonical gofmt spacing; actual extra field alignment. Mechanical commit d7749792 applies that one normalization. Full formatting audit, go vet ./... and CGO_ENABLED=0 GOOS=windows GOARCH=amd64 go build ./... exited0; readonly module-stat cache warning retained in the Windows log.
